title: Packers' Christian Watson makes stunning 'TNF' return after hospital trip - USA Today
description: Christian Watson suffered a rib injury that forced him out of "Thursday Night Football" against the Panthers. He was taken to the hospital in an ambulance but later returned.

title: Thursday Night Football: Packers hold on for 27-19 win over Panthers - NBC Sports
